simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּרָה (H6509) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: פָּרָה (pârâh) means to bear fruit (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: Deut 29 17.

definitions.usage: bear, bring forth (fruit), (be, cause to be, make) fruitful, grow, increase.
definitions.full: H6509. parah [ מָּרָה ] verb bear fruit, be fruitful (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew 1, מְּרִי = Biblical Hebrew; Phoenician פר fruit ; Ethiopic , blossom, bear fruit ; Assyrian pir'u , posterity ; compare also מֵּירָא ᵑ7 Syriac fruit , and Ba ZMG xii (1887), 604 ): — Qal Perfect 3plural מָּרוּ Exod 1:7 ; 1 plural consecutive וּפָרִינוּ Gen 26:22 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְרֶה Isa 11:1 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular מְּרֵה Gen 35:11 , masculine plural מְּרוּ 1:22 +; Participle active מֹּרֶה Deut 29:17 , feminine מֹּרִיָּה Ezek 19:10 ; Isa 17:6 , מֹּרָת (Ges § 80g ; for * מֹּרַיַת Lag BN 81 ) Gen 49:22 (twice in verse); — 1 of men and animals , Exod 23:30 (E) Gen 26:22 (J); especially + רבה Jer 3:16 ; 23:3 ; Ezek 36:11 ; Gen 35:11 ; 47:27 (P), and שָׁרַץ (P) 8:17 ; 9:7 ; Exod 1:7 , וגו וּמִלְאוּ וּרְבוּ ׳מְּרוּ Gen 1:22 , 28 ; 9:1 . 2 of vine , מֹּרִיָּה גֶּפֶן Isa 32:12 fruitful vine , so Psa 128:3 (simile of wife); compare (in figurative of Israel) Ezek 19:10 ; in Messianic prediction Isa 11:1 a shoot from his [Jesse's] roots shall bear fruit ; with accusative פ ׳שֹׁרֶשׁ ראֹשׁ figurative, Deut 29:17 a root bearing gall (as its fruit); יֶשַׁע יִפְרוּ Isa 45:8 is dubious, read perhaps 3 feminine singular תֵּפֶר let earth be fruitful in salvation (Oort and others); Participle f., as substantive, הַמֹּרַיָּה the fruit-bearer , poetic for tree, 17:6 (compare [ סָעִיף ] 2 ); so מֹּרָת בֵּן Gen 49:22 (twice in verse) Joseph is son of a fruit-bearer , i.e. a fruitful bough. Hiph`il 1. cause to bear fruit , 2 make fruitful , subject ׳י with accusative of man or people: 1 Perfect 3masculine singular suffix הִפְרַנִי Gen 41:52 (E). 2 in P, וְהִפְרֵתִ֫י Gen 17:6 , 20 ( רֵיתֵ֫י -), + הִרְבָּה Lev 26:9 (H); Imperfect 3masculine singular jussive וְיַרְבְּךָ יַפְרְךָ Gen 28:3 , וַיֶּפֶר Psa 105:24 ; Participle וְהִרְבִּיתִךָ מַפְרְךָ הִנְנִי Gen 48:4 . 3 shew fruitfullness, bear fruit (Ges § 53 c, d, g ): Imperfect 3masculine singular יַפְרִיא Hosea 13:15 (as if from פרא ).
